scope: Finite scalar checks; no physical-model certification or universal proof by computation.
recovery_comparison_limit: Only the supplied primary-source formula family was compared; finite k=1..40 does not prove the all-k simplification or absolute optimality.

recovery_families_compared.rank_only: f=min(1,2^(r-2k)); dimension score<=min(1,2^(r-k)); refined discrimination inverse applied to min(pair MUB PGM (1+f)/2, BCW R3 (d*f+1/d)/2, DFW binomial family)
recovery_families_compared.algebra_aware: f=min(1,2^(r-2k),2^(s-k)); dimension score<=min(1,2^(r-s-k)); same refined discrimination and recovery family including BCW R3; maximize over integer s with c=r-2s>=0
recovery_families_compared.algebra_aware_equality_proof: For r<=k choose s=0,c=r. For k<=r<=2k choose s=r-k,c=2k-r. Both choices attain the rank-only family. They fit every width n>=k when r<=2n. Consequently adding the existing coherent-block bottleneck does not alter the rank-only upper curve in this width regime.
recovery_families_compared.finite_width_limit: The stored unconstrained-rank comparison allows every s with c>=0 and fits n>=k. If n<k, enforce s+c<=n; this can strengthen either family.
